final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS r, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.n) AS avg_scans, AVG(g.r - a.m) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.r > a.m
